description_en: Queries the resolution settings for private domain names. You can filter the query by private domain name or resolution type
description_zh: 查询内网域名解析，支持根据内网域名或解析类型查询
kebab_example: aliyun cloudapi list-private-dns --intranet-domain api.demo.com --type A --page-size 1 --page-number 1 --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListPrivateDNS

parameters.help_en:
The type of private domain name resolution.

- VPC: Authorizes resolution for a VPC. Only dedicated instances of the classic type can be attached.

- A: Creates an A record. Only dedicated instances of the VPC-integrated type can be attached
parameters.help_zh:
内网域名解析的类型
- VPC：针对VPC授权解析，仅支持绑定传统类型专享实例；
- A：支持创建A记录，仅支持绑定VPC融合类型专享实例
parameters.name: type
